entry.name: Mozilla Firefox (Alpine package)
entry.verified: Alpine package installed with 'apk add --usermode --root ~/ibbrowsers/root --initdb' from the distro repos; apk verifies the RSA-signed APKINDEX and each package's hash against /etc/apk/keys; geckodriver .tar.gz.asc verified with the same Mozilla release key (subkey 09BEED63F3462A2DFFAB3B875ECB6497C1A20256) (Mozilla's geckodriver is static-pie and runs on musl)
entry.notes:
driver is a wrapper that sources ~/ibbrowsers/env.sh (LD_LIBRARY_PATH -> ~/ibbrowsers/root/usr/lib[,pulseaudio,firefox], FONTCONFIG_FILE, ICU_DATA) then execs the driver; binaries run on the system musl loader (same musl as the root). The VM's sshd has 'AllowTcpForwarding no', so ssh -L is refused ('administratively prohibited'); reach the driver with a stdio tunnel instead, e.g. one `ssh x@10.0.1.200 nc 127.0.0.1

` per connection (busybox nc) -- that is how the smoke ran. ICU_DATA is required: Alpine's firefox segfaults when ICU can't find /usr/share/icu/78.1. geckodriver: forward with the SAME local port as the remote --port (geckodriver rejects a Host header whose port differs: 'Invalid Host header 127.0.0.1:').

served: no tunnel: Error: remote port forwarding failed for listen port 33566
